name: Pansage
description: Pansage, the Grass Monkey Pokémon. Able to evolve into Simisage. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.
